headline: Trump rejects AI slowdown plea from Anthropic, OpenAI leadership
body: The heads of Anthropic, OpenAI, and xAI requested that the Trump administration support measures to pace frontier AI development, but Trump rejected the call, signaling continued acceleration of AI capabilities without regulatory constraints. This policy stance removes potential brakes on model development timelines that could have affected healthcare AI deployment cycles and clinical validation requirements. Healthcare organizations should expect faster vendor innovation cycles and compressed evaluation windows as AI companies race to scale capabilities without pacing mechanisms. The geopolitical dimension adds complexity: China criticized the slowdown appeals as Cold War tactics, intensifying global competition that will shape which AI models dominate clinical workflows and EHR integrations over the next 18-24 months.
